title: selaginella moritziana var. normalis
intro:
Selaginella moritziana var. normalis, commonly known as Spikemoss or Spiked Moss, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Selaginellaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, and its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella moritziana var. normalis include its use as an antiseptic, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory agent, as well as its ability to boost the immune system and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.

Note: More research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of Selaginella moritziana var. normalis for medicinal use.
